response.text:
The goal needs a contract change, so I'm stopping without a proposal.

=== ACTION: limitation ===
{"reason": "Returning each customer's phone number needs a contract change, not just a new implementation. The output schema of customers.lookup@1 declares exactly /customerId, /name, /email, /tier and /since. It has no phone field. The preservation rule 'output.return-no-more' requires any replacement to 'return only what the current output schema allows', so adding /phone would break the contract. Changing contracts is outside what I may do. Separately, the capability declares no verification methods (evidence.methods is empty, establishable: false), so even a permitted change could not be verified here. To meet the goal, the contract owner would need to add an optional /phone output to this capability or publish a new version (e.g. customers.lookup@2). That would also need a review of billing.contact@1, which depends on this capability. Once that contract change exists, the handler in src/handlers/customers.lookup.mjs (using src/legacy/crm.mjs) can be updated to fill in the field."}
=== END ACTION ===
